warn_unverified.description: Warn UNVERIFIED_CONTENT when a hit or an opened document has not been verified by a person

verified_only.description: Search and open only documents a person (a human or an owner) has verified

lanes.description: The retrieval lanes; bm25 is the only one (no embedding model by default)

drafters.description: Plugin instances whose pipeline steps this instance accepts drafted proposals from, each with where its creates go (phase 4 section 3.2; step 3c, amendment 14): the host attests who drafted, and every other claim is verified here. Default {}: an attested submission is PROPOSAL_DRAFTER_NOT_ALLOWED

targets.description: By space: the collection, and an optional fixed prefix, a drafted create must use exactly, <collection>/<prefix>/<derived id>. A drafter with no target in a space cannot draft creates there; its verify and deprecate drafts are unaffected. The drafter's own configuration must name the same target; this one is enforced

collection.description: A markdown collection of the space

prefix.description: One to eight plain segments joined by /: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, no dots, no leading or trailing /

areas.description: Approval areas: the part of a space one approval policy governs. The most specific collection and prefix governs a document; a proposal for a document no area covers is PROPOSAL_NO_AREA

prefix.description: A document id prefix inside the collection; empty is the whole collection

approvers.description: principal:human:<id> or group:<id> entries; empty admits any human

auto.description: The auto-approval rules the area opts into (phase 4 section 8.3, owner decision 1); default [], off. The one kind, deprecate-declared, lets knowledge-auto-approve apply a drafted deprecate whose declaration a person's applied proposal wrote; nothing else is ever applied without a person
